text: Nurses keep raising the hospital's botched staffing plan.
Nurses keep asking whether the hospital's staffing plan was botched.

Parents debated whether the school's curriculum was dumbed down.

The audit will cover whether the ministry missed its climate targets.

Commuters asked whether the agency mismanaged the train network.

The panel reviewed whether the regulator's AI rules were rushed.

The committee will examine whether the fund had shortfalls this year.

Voters are discussing whether the mayor broke his transit promises.

Reporters pressed the board about whether it concealed losses.

The union asked whether the plant's safety cuts were reckless.

The review will address whether the council delayed the permit.

The new surveillance rule treats patients, but not the way informers treated neighbors.

Cutting the subsidy affects farmers, though not the way a drought starves crops.

Closing the ward affects patients, unlike the way a captain abandons a sinking ship.

The tariff costs consumers, but not the way a pickpocket robs a crowd.

Jailing the activists is unlike the way tyrants crush dissent.
Approving this merger is the same as approving every merger.
Approving this merger is not the same as approving every merger.

The loan burdens the country, though not the way quicksand traps a traveler.

Censoring the site restricts readers, unlike the way book-burners silenced readers.

Raising fees affects students, but not the way a gate locks out trespassers.

Backing this bill is not like backing the whole agenda.

We could privatize the water supply, upgrade it publicly, or fix the leaks.

We could fund the police fully, reform them, or fund prevention instead.
Either the university raises fees or it closes.
The university could raise fees, cut costs, or seek new funding.
We build the airport or the region stays poor forever.
We could build the airport, expand the rail link, or invest elsewhere.
Either we accept the trade deal, or we do nothing.
We could accept the trade deal, renegotiate it, or seek other partners.
You back the vaccine mandate or you endanger everyone.
We could mandate the vaccine, recommend it, or expand access.
Either we dam the river or the valley floods every year.
We could dam the river, restore wetlands, or improve drainage.
We cut pensions now or the system dies.
We could trim pensions, raise contributions, or broaden the base.
Either you support the merger, or you oppose jobs.
You can support the merger, question parts of it, or oppose it.
We ban the app or our children are lost.
We could ban the app, regulate it, or teach safer use.

Asked about our hospital waits, we explain our waits this year.

When they question our emissions, we describe our emissions now.

Challenged on our debt, we address our debt this term.
They raise our school results, so we raise their results from before.
They raise our school results, so we explain our results this year.
Asked about our budget, we bring up their budget from last year.
Asked about our budget, we clarify our budget this year.
When critics note our delays, we note their delays under the old board.
When critics note our delays, we account for our delays now.
Questioned on our crime rate, we cite their crime rate earlier.
Questioned on our crime rate, we address our crime rate today.
They mention our layoffs, so we mention their layoffs in the past.
They mention our layoffs, so we justify our layoffs this quarter.
Asked about our spending, we point to their spending before us.
Asked about our spending, we explain our spending this year.
When they ask about our taxes, we ask about their taxes last time.
When they ask about our taxes, we clarify our taxes this year.

People are asking whether the regulator fails consumers.

People are asking whether the program delivers.

People are asking whether the deal sells out workers.

People are asking whether the council spends wisely.

People are asking whether the agency wasted the relief funds.

People are asking whether the railway is broken.

People are asking whether the plan misses targets.

Unemployment rose after the reform, but the cause is debated.

Allow one waiver and some rules might be questioned, though it can be limited.

Rents climbed after the ban lifted, but what raised them is debated.

Drop the test at one clinic and others might follow, or might not.
